$description: The landing page's settings and demo content. build.mjs reads this, fills src/index.html and writes dist/. Page copy lives in src/index.html; the beaver comes from the app's own sprite; What's new comes from GitHub Releases at build time.

ogImage.$description: The link-preview picture shown when the page is shared. og-image.py draws it from these settings and the beaver sprite into file, which is committed: run python3 site/og-image.py again after changing either. build.mjs copies it to dist and points og:image at it. Sizes are in pixels; tracking is the extra space between letters.
ogImage.alt: Whittle: whittle down your to-do list. The pixel beaver on graph paper.
ogImage.title: Whittle
ogImage.foot: ANY MODEL · YOUR OWN KEYS · NO SERVER

releases.$description: The newest published release lists up to latestItems of its bold lead lines, each with its first sentence; the ones before it get a row each, up to earlier, summed up by up to summaryLeads leads. The APK is the release asset matching apkPattern.

stage.$description: While Whittle is in beta: a label beside the name, and a word beside the version. Remove the block to drop both.
stage.label: Beta

chores.$description: The hero's to-do list. Each chore's steps play in turn under it; the last step stays as its receipt once the chore is struck through.
chores.title: Saturday

items.text: Wake me at 6:30, it's gym day
Which phone plan in my email is cheaper?
Split the Goa trip bill from this PDF
Make me a chai timer app
Every Monday, brief me on my week

questions.answer: Two stand out, both under ₹4,500. Reviews and links attached.

questions.q: What did the team decide about the launch?
questions.answer: Launch moved to the 14th. Two issues still open, both assigned.
A bit high. Similar ones sold for ₹22–26k this month.
